args: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY="$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s firecrawl_api_key -w 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$FIRECRAWL_API_KEY" ]; then echo "Missing macOS Keychain item 'firecrawl_api_key'. Run: security add-generic-password -U -a \"$USER\" -s firecrawl_api_key -w \"<FIRECRAWL_API_KEY>\"" >&2; exit 1; fi; export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY; exec npx -y firecrawl-mcp
